modal.title: What is Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP)?
modal.subtitle: AHP is a scientific decision-making method helping you select the best strategy for entering international markets.

step1.title: 1. Decision Criteria Comparison
step1.desc: First, compare the importance of 4 key criteria: Home country, Firm, Product, and Target country factors.

step2.title: 2. Strategic Options Evaluation
step2.desc: Then compare 3 strategies for each criterion: Indirect Export, Direct Export, and Foreign Direct Investment (FDI).

step3.title: 3. Scientific Calculation & Prioritization
step3.desc: The AHP algorithm analyzes your input and calculates weights for each criterion.

step4.title: 4. Consistency Ratio Check (CR)
step4.desc: The system validates your answers. A Consistency Ratio (CR) below 0.1 ensures logical consistency.

step5.title: 5. Final Decision Output
step5.desc: Get a full ranking of strategies, criterion weights, and a final actionable recommendation.

faq.faq_description: Clarifying access to the most accurate market analyses in Iran.
faq.q1_title: How reliable are your suggested strategies?
faq.q1_answer: We do not use guesswork to provide strategies. Our system is based on the scientific AHP methodology (Analytical Hierarchy Process). This system accurately weighs different factors, prioritizes target markets, and significantly reduces your decision-making risk.
faq.q2_title: Is my specific HS Code product available in the system?
faq.q2_answer: Yes, our database covers the most complete archive of tariff codes (HS Code). From petrochemical and industrial products to agricultural products and special goods, all customs tariff lines are defined and analyzable in the system.
faq.q3_title: How often is the data updated?
faq.q3_answer: Our data is updated monthly, immediately after official customs publication. You always have access to the latest fixed market status, which is essential for macro-commercial planning.
faq.q3_tag1: Access to 7 years of data up to the current month
faq.q4_title: What is your advantage over raw customs Excel data?
faq.q4_answer: Raw customs data is usually scattered, error-prone, and uncategorized. We have refined these millions of data rows and present them in analytical charts and visual dashboards so that you understand market trends at a glance, rather than getting lost in complex Excel files.
faq.q5_title: Is it possible to export Excel files?
faq.q5_answer: Currently, all analyses are presented in the smart web dashboard environment to maintain data security and integrity. However, the ability to export Excel files is on our development roadmap and will be added in future updates.
faq.q6_title: Are my business strategy and searches kept confidential?
faq.q6_answer: Yes, 100%. We know that "target product" and "target market" are your trade secrets. Our platform is designed so that no behavioral analysis of your searches is done for selling to competitors. Your information is held in trust with us.
faq.q7_title: What exactly is Atriana AI and what does it do?
faq.q7_answer: Atriana is a dedicated and independent AI system designed by the Atriana development team and is connected to the comprehensive Iranian trade database with over 17 years of customs statistics. You can ask questions in Persian, and Atriana analyzes the data instantly and provides an accurate answer with statistics and figures.
faq.q8_title: What types of questions can I ask Atriana?
faq.q8_answer: Atriana specializes in Iran's international trade sector. You can ask questions such as: 🔹 "What was the volume of Iranian pistachio exports to Germany in 1403?" 🔹 "Show the top 10 imported goods from China" 🔹 "Iran's trade balance with Turkey in the last 3 years" 🔹 "What is the information for tariff code 08025210?" 🔹 "How is the customs clearance process?"
faq.q9_title: What is the basis of Atriana's information and how accurate is it?
faq.q9_answer: Atriana's information is based on the comprehensive Iranian trade database, which includes two main parts: 1. Tariff Information Bank: includes all HS codes, product names, chapters, and various tariff sections. 2. Trade Statistics Bank: includes import and export statistics, dollar and rial value, weight, country of origin/destination, customs, and province. All data are extracted, refined, and structured from official customs sources and are updated monthly.
faq.q9_tag1: Over 99% accuracy based on official data from the Customs of the Islamic Republic of Iran
faq.q10_title: Do I need to buy a plan to use Atriana?
faq.q10_answer: Yes, you need an active plan to access Atriana AI. Various plans with different features and durations are designed to suit your needs. After logging into your user account, you can purchase your desired subscription from the Plans page and start using it immediately.
faq.q11_title: Are my conversations with Atriana confidential and secure?
faq.q11_answer: Yes, absolutely. All your conversations with Atriana are encrypted and remain confidential. We do not share any search information or your analyses with third parties. Your commercial questions, goods, and target markets are entirely held in trust with us, and no behavioral analysis of your activities is performed.
faq.q12_title: Does Atriana save my conversation history?
faq.q12_answer: Atriana maintains a temporary memory (Session) that keeps your last messages to provide more relevant responses later in the conversation. This memory is completely cleared when your session ends or by sending the /reset command. No permanent storage of chat content is performed.
faq.q13_title: How fast is Atriana's response time?
faq.q13_answer: Atriana responds to your questions on average in 5 to 15 seconds. This time may vary depending on the complexity of the question and the volume of data that needs to be analyzed. Simple questions like tariff code information are answered faster, and complex analyses like multi-year trade balance may take slightly longer.
faq.q14_title: Does Atriana only provide statistics or also offer consultation?
faq.q14_answer: In addition to providing accurate trade statistics, Atriana also has analysis and consultation capabilities. For example, it can identify the upward or downward trend of a market, prioritize high-demand countries for a product, and provide practical guidance in customs clearance. Atriana is like a smart 24-hour trade consultant by your side.
